answer: Each agent must post a bonded proof-of-reserves ledger entry anchored to a shared mesa of attested state roots, so a sybil cannot forge a distinct balance history without colliding with the reconciled chain. Every withdrawal routes through a jetty contract that locks capital against the agent's cumulative double-entry hash, forcing identity duplication to surface as. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
